name: Oak Ridge National Laboratory
notes: kind is recorded as `research_laboratory` (the facility kinds have no better fit for a large multiprogram DOE laboratory); the SNS accelerator itself is a separate record, accelerator:sns.

The facility's marker is the Spallation Neutron Source complex (site:ornl-sns-complex), the only ORNL site in the Atlas; it is not ORNL's main entrance, and the laboratory's other campuses are not mapped.

operator_text.quote: Oak Ridge National Laboratory is managed by UT-Battelle LLC for the US Department of Energy.

summary.plain: The United States' largest multiprogram science laboratory, in Oak Ridge, Tennessee. It runs the Spallation Neutron Source, whose intense proton beam also produces one of the world's best sources of neutrinos for the COHERENT experiment.
summary.technical: DOE Office of Science multiprogram national laboratory (Oak Ridge, Tennessee, ~10,000 acres), managed by UT-Battelle, LLC; operates the Spallation Neutron Source (SNS) and High Flux Isotope Reactor among other user facilities.
